verdict.rationale:
LaunchDarkly's SDK architecture is documented and confirmed by hands-on users: SDKs download all flags on connect then receive live updates via a streaming (SSE) connection, and LaunchDarkly's own Relay Proxy exists specifically to keep this fast/resilient at scale (launchdarkly-docs-13, launchdarkly-docs-32, launchdarkly-comm-2, launchdarkly-comm-9). Targeting/flag toggling docs (launchdarkly-docs-1, launchdarkly-docs-19, launchdarkly-docs-31) support the on/off 'kill switch' use case, and community reports describe 'minimal latency' change propagation via SSE, corroborating the story.
missing for 10: explicit vendor-stated propagation SLA/latency numbers, an explicit 'kill switch' terminology/case study, and independent hands-on confirmation that toggling actually halts traffic within seconds (one community note flags occasional API/setting-lookup timeouts, a minor caveat).
